assetBaseUrl.description: Prefix put in front of decoration asset urls, which are otherwise rooted at `/`. Needed when the backend does not sit at the root of the origin the client is served from: an origin of its own, e.g. "https://screeps.example.com", or the path a proxy mounts it under. Prepended verbatim, so it takes either.

builtin.description: Whether to load the decoration pack bundled with the server.

grantAll.description: Whether every user owns the whole decoration catalog. With this off, decorations must be handed out explicitly with `xxscreeps manage decoration grant`.

packs.description: Additional decoration packs to load. Each entry is a path to a `pack.json`, or to the directory holding one.

requireRoomOwnership.description: Whether placing a decoration requires the player to control or reserve the room.

season.description: Decorations every room shows by default, the way the official season servers dress the whole world. Each entry names a decoration from the catalog, with optional property values replacing its seeds. Served after what players placed, so a player's own placement wins over the season's; the world map never shows them.
